# Repository instructions — FPT ICO Summit 2026

Before coding, read `AGENTS.md` and all files in `docs/`.

Key rules:

- Public name is **FPT ICO Summit 2026**.
- Use Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS.
- MVP is a single-page landing site deployed to Vercel.
- Photos/partner logos are managed through centralized data and Cloudinary URLs; core FPT/ICO branding may be local.
- Do not install Cloudinary SDK, database, CMS, or animation packages unless explicitly requested.
- Do not invent confirmed partners, speakers, scholarships, detailed agenda times, registration links, or event facts.
- Public partner UI must show only explicitly confirmed partners.
- Use `https://cantho.fpt.edu.vn/360-tour/` as an external 360-tour CTA; do not rebuild it.
- Prefer Server Components, semantic HTML, accessible UI, responsive layout, and subtle CSS motion.
- Work one requested component/phase at a time.
- Do not run install/build/deploy/destructive terminal commands unless the user explicitly asks. Output the exact command for the user to run instead.
